items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: a marvelous upcoming bass player that I have been playing with, Genevieve Rose, who is looking forward to that

ctx.x: What’s in the near future for you? I know you mentioned you’re going to be going to Europe with a group from U Mass.

Yes I’m going out with Trade Winds, and some marvelous players that I’m excited about, and Fred Tillis on saxophone, and a marvelous upcoming bass player that I have been playing with, Genevieve Rose, who is looking forward to that, and I’m doing a cruise to Hawaii with the Benny Goodman big band, it’s a jazz cruise, and there’ll be several other groups on there and we’ll trade off and I’m excited about that. It’s a challenge to sit in Mr. Krupa’s chair. I’m boning up for it.

items.title: Genevieve Rose interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: I’ve got something that should be, I think it’s October 17th with Sheila Jordan and Harold Danko as a piano player, and Greg Caputo is the drummer, and that’s at the Iron Horse in Northampton.

ctx.x: What’s the next kind of important gig you have coming up? Any name people?

That’s hard to say. I mean I know like I’ll be doing the Jazz in July workshop in the summer as a kind of like a faculty member, and I did that last year too, as the house rhythm section for vocalists. And I’ve got something that should be, I think it’s October 17th with Sheila Jordan and Harold Danko as a piano player, and Greg Caputo is the drummer, and that’s at the Iron Horse in Northampton. But that’s a little far off right now. But that will be one of the first gigs under my own name, so that will be nice.
Well you’re certainly rubbing shoulders with some good company.
